name: Hot Fire

faqs.question: What does 🥵🔥 mean on a group chat?
faqs.answer: In a group chat 🥵🔥 reads as a reaction-coded stamp. The combo usually means the sender is reacting to something specific in the thread above them.

faqs.question: What does 🥵🔥 mean if I do not reply?
faqs.answer: If you do not reply to 🥵🔥, the combo usually stays a benign reaction. Senders rarely escalate over an unreplied reaction-coded emoji.

faqs.question: Can I use 🥵🔥 for sympathy?
faqs.answer: For sympathy prefer heart or flower emojis. Reaction-coded combos read too loud for sympathy-coded moments.

faqs.question: Is 🥵🔥 flirty?
faqs.answer: 🥵🔥 is not flirty by default. The reaction register is broader than flirting; reach for flirt-coded combos when attraction is the point.
